//: Settings for studying this project in VS Code.
The examples explain themselves line by line, which pushes the real code
lines far apart. These settings make folding behave the way you want.
Ctrl+K  Ctrl+0   fold every explanation at once
Ctrl+K Ctrl+0..5 fold / unfold comments only  (Ctrl+K then Ctrl+C toggles all comments)
Long explanations are /* block comments */ on purpose, because block
comments are the only comment style every editor can collapse as a group.
editor.fontFamily: Cascadia Code, JetBrains Mono, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
